bug_description.original: Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 8 found by fuzz target fuzzerPolygonToCellsExperimental [asan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/372515086
bug_description.normalized: In maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental, the containment mode is unconditionally overridden to CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX for estimating the output buffer size. However, in iterStepPolygonCompact, the fine-grained cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon line-intersection check at line 511 only fires for CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING, not CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX. For certain polygon geometries, this causes the OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode to miss boundary-crossing cells, yielding an underestimated count (sz=3). When polygonToCellsExperimental subsequently fills the calloc'd buffer using the caller's actual CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING mode, the line-intersection check finds additional cells, and the write out[i++] at polyfill.c:720 overflows the 24-byte heap buffer.

source.description: maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental unconditionally overrides the iterator's containment mode to CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX for size estimation, regardless of the caller's requested flags. For the PoC polygon, the OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode produces an undercount because it lacks the cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon check that CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING has.
source.value_from: Hardcoded override; the attacker-controlled polygon is already bound to the iterator via _iterInitPolygonCompact(polygon, res, flags) at line 752. The polygon geometry determines which cells cross the boundary and are missed by OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode.

sink.description: polygonToCellsExperimental iterates with the caller's actual CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING mode, which includes the cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon check and finds more cells than the OVERLAPPING_BBOX-based size estimate predicted. When i reaches 3 (the allocated sz), this 8-byte write lands 0 bytes past the end of the 24-byte heap buffer, triggering ASAN heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 8.

root_cause.description: The cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon line-intersection check in iterStepPolygonCompact only fires when mode == CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING, excluding CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX. Since maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental forces OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode for size estimation, boundary-crossing cells are not counted by the fine-grained check. The OVERLAPPING_BBOX fallback block at line 519 uses a coarser bbox-based approximation that can miss cells. The fix adds mode == CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX to this condition, ensuring the size estimate is a superset of what any mode can produce.

tainted_value_origin.description: The size estimate sz is produced by maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental from the attacker-controlled polygon. The function uses a hardcoded OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode that can undercount boundary-crossing cells, making sz an insufficient allocation size for the actual CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING fill.

coarse_trace.summary: Overrides the containment mode to CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX and iterates via iterStepPolygonCompact to estimate the output cell count. The OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode lacks the cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon line-intersection check (line 511 only matches CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING), causing the iteration to miss boundary-crossing cells for the PoC polygon and return an underestimated count sz=3.
Allocates calloc(sz=3, sizeof(H3Index)=8) = 24 bytes based on the underestimated size, then calls polygonToCellsExperimental with the actual CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING flags.

Iterates with CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING mode. The cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon check at line 511 fires for this mode and finds additional boundary-crossing cells. Writing out[i++] = iter.cell at line 720 when i >= 3 overflows the 24-byte buffer, causing heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 8.

fine_trace.note: maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental overrides the iterator's containment mode to CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX (value 3), discarding the caller's flags argument. The iterator already holds the attacker-controlled polygon geometry from _iterInitPolygonCompact at line 752. This mode is intended to be the most permissive (a superset of all modes), but it omits the cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon fine-grained check, so for certain polygon geometries it undercounts.

During the OVERLAPPING_BBOX size-estimation iteration, this condition evaluates to false because mode is CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX (3), not CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING (2). The cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon line-intersection check is therefore skipped. For the PoC polygon, at least one cell whose boundary crosses the polygon without having its center inside or being fully contained is missed by this path. The OVERLAPPING_BBOX fallback block at line 519 uses coarser bbox-based approximation and does not catch this cell. The fix adds || mode == CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX to this condition.

depends_on.via: iter._flags = CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX propagates as mode via FLAG_GET_CONTAINMENT_MODE(iter->_flags) at line 429

fine_trace.note: Allocates sz * sizeof(H3Index) = 3 * 8 = 24 bytes for the output buffer. sz=3 is the underestimated count returned by maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental because OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode missed boundary-crossing cells. ASAN confirms the allocated region is [0x503000000280, 0x503000000298), a 24-byte heap region.

depends_on.via: The undercount from the OVERLAPPING_BBOX iteration propagates through *out += childrenSize (line 786) into sz via the &sz parameter

fine_trace.note: polygonToCellsExperimental iterates with the caller's actual CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING mode (flags=2). In iterStepPolygonCompact, the condition at line 511 now evaluates to true (mode == CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING), so cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon fires and finds boundary-crossing cells that the size estimate missed. When i reaches 3, out[3] = iter.cell writes 8 bytes at offset 24, which is 0 bytes past the end of the 24-byte heap allocation. ASAN detects heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 8 at 0x503000000298.

depends_on.via: out points to the 24-byte calloc'd buffer; i has been incremented past sz=3 by prior successful iterations
mode == CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING evaluates to true (flags=2), enabling cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon

parser_admitted.description: The PoC input is at least sizeof(inputArgs) bytes. populateGeoLoop succeeds for the outer geoloop. The fuzzer iterates flags from 0 to CONTAINMENT_INVALID-1 (0..3), calling run() for each. The crash occurs when flags=2 (CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING).

size_estimate_completes.description: maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental returns E_SUCCESS with a nonzero sz < MAX_SZ, so the run() function proceeds to allocate and call polygonToCellsExperimental.

format.name: raw
format.contract: A binary blob at least sizeof(inputArgs) bytes that, when parsed as a GeoPolygon, produces polygon geometry where at least one H3 cell's boundary crosses the polygon edge without the cell center being inside the polygon or the cell being fully contained. This specific geometry triggers the CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX undercount because the cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon check (line 511) is skipped for OVERLAPPING_BBOX mode, while the OVERLAPPING_BBOX fallback (line 519) also misses the cell.
